title: Mechanisms of LouDan LiFei granule attenuate inflammatory injury in AECOPD:A network pharmacology and experimental validation.
authors: Guo, Jing; Zhou, Lin-Shui; Lv, Xin; Wang, Jian-Feng; Xu, Ting-Zhen; Wang, Zhong-Hai; Guo, Si-Jia; Guo, An; Wang, Jing-Xia; Gao, Xue-Min; Sun, Zeng-Tao; Wu, Qing-Yuan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方LDLF对慢阻肺急性加重期的抗炎机制，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心是药物-靶点-疾病通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) significantly contributes to the high mortality rate associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It leads to a decline in health status, increased rates of readmission, and accelerated disease progression. LouDan LiFei granule (LDLF), a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) granule, has demonstrated efficacy in treating AECOPD patients. However, its underlying regulatory mechanisms remain to be fully elucidated. PURPOSE: To investigate the pharmacodynamic components and regulatory mechanisms of LDLF in the treatment of AECOPD, and to provide a scientific basis for the further clinical application of subsequent drugs. METHODS: This study focused on identifying the pharmacodynamic components and regulatory mechanisms of LDLF. In vivo experiments, we established a rat model of AECOPD and systematically evaluated the therapeutic effect by monitoring the body weight, lung function and pathological changes in lung tissue. UPLC-MS/MS was employed to detect the components of LDLF medicated serum. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were utilized to determine the therapeutic targets and pathways of LDLF in AECOPD treatment. Finally, we further verified the research results by establishing AECOPD moded in rat and BEAS-2B. RESULTS: Our study revealed that LDLF significantly reduced inflammation and pathological damage in lung tissue of AECOPD model rats and improved pulmonary function. UPLC-MS/MS analysis identified 1502 compounds in LDLF medicated serum, primarily comprising flavonoids, terpenoids, alkaloids, ketones, and aldehydes acids. Network pharmacology results suggested that LDLF may treat AECOPD by modulating Th17 cell differentiation and signaling pathways related to IL-17, T cell receptor, and NOD-like receptor. Molecular docking confirmed stable interactions between core compounds and their targets. In vivo validation showed that LDLF redused the proportion of Th17 cells and increased Treg cells proportion in peripheral blood of rat model. Protein expression levels of FOXP3 were elevated, and RORgamma and STAT3 were reduced in lung tissue. Inflammatory markers (IL-6, IL-1beta, IL-8, IL-17, TNF-alpha, IL-10, and TGF-beta1) in serum and balf were improved after LDLF treatment. Additionally, LDLF significantly inhibited the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway at protein and mRNA levels in lung. In vitro experiments demonstrated that LDLF enhanced the BEAS-2B cells viability and inhibited inflammatory markers IL-6 and TNF-alpha as well as key targets of NLRP3, STAT3, CASP3, and AKT1. CONCLUSIONS: This research highlights the potential for LDLF in the treatment of AECOPD and enhances our understanding of its pathogenic and therapeutic mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重（AECOPD）显著增加了与慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）相关的高死亡率。它导致健康状况下降、再入院率增加以及疾病进展加速。娄丹利肺颗粒（LDLF），一种中药（TCM）颗粒，已在治疗AECOPD患者中显示出疗效。然而，其潜在调控机制仍需全面阐明。目的：探讨LDLF治疗AECOPD的药效成分及调控机制，为后续药物的进一步临床应用提供科学依据。方法：本研究聚焦于识别LDLF的药效成分及调控机制。在体内实验中，我们建立了AECOPD大鼠模型，并通过监测体重、肺功能及肺组织病理变化系统评估治疗效果。采用UPLC-MS/MS检测LDLF含药血清中的成分。利用网络药理学和分子对接确定LDLF治疗AECOPD的治疗靶点及通路。最后，通过建立大鼠AECOPD模型和BEAS-2B细胞模型进一步验证研究结果。结果：我们的研究表明，LDLF显著减轻了AECOPD模型大鼠肺组织中的炎症和病理损伤，并改善了肺功能。UPLC-MS/MS分析在LDLF含药血清中鉴定出1502种化合物，主要包括黄酮类、萜类、生物碱类、酮类和醛酸类。网络药理学结果表明，LDLF可能通过调节Th17细胞分化及与IL-17、T细胞受体和NOD样受体相关的信号通路来治疗AECOPD。分子对接证实了核心化合物与其靶点之间的稳定相互作用。体内验证显示，LDLF降低了模型大鼠外周血中Th17细胞的比例，并增加了Treg细胞的比例。肺组织中FOXP3蛋白表达水平升高，而RORgamma和STAT3表达降低。LDLF治疗后，血清和支气管肺泡灌洗液（balf）中的炎症标志物（IL-6、IL-1beta、IL-8、IL-17、TNF-alpha、IL-10和TGF-beta1）得到改善。此外，LDLF在肺组织蛋白和mRNA水平上显著抑制了NLRP3炎症小体通路。体外实验表明，LDLF增强了BEAS-2B细胞活力，并抑制了炎症标志物IL-6和TNF-alpha以及NLRP3、STAT3、CASP3和AKT1的关键靶点。结论：本研究凸显了LDLF在治疗AECOPD中的潜力，并增进了我们对其发病和治疗机制的理解。
